summary.id: Hawazan melawan koalisi pimpinan GIE. Perundingan damai gagal 1 Nov, Hawazan mengklaim menang 2 Nov (belum diverifikasi), dan UDC bubar 3 Nov. Koalisi kini pecah: AOCTL dikeluarkan lalu berbalik melawan GIE, dan SDU mundur setelah satu pertempuran terakhir 7 Nov.
summary.en: Hawazan against a GIE-led coalition. Peace talks failed on 1 Nov, Hawazan claimed victory on 2 Nov (unverified), and the UDC disbanded on 3 Nov. The coalition is now splitting: AOCTL was expelled and turned on GIE, and SDU leaves after one last battle on 7 Nov.

note.id: Pendiri dan pemimpin koalisi; diserang sejak 16 Okt, menurut GIE
note.en: Coalition founder and leader; attacked since 16 Oct, per GIE

note.id: Sempat mundur 28 Okt, diserang balik 29 Okt
Keluar dari koalisi 4 Nov; mundur total setelah pertempuran terakhir 7 Nov 19.00
note.en: Left the coalition on 4 Nov; withdraws fully after a last battle on 7 Nov 19:00

note.id: Dikeluarkan dari koalisi 4 Nov, lalu menyatakan perang ke GIE
note.en: Expelled from the coalition on 4 Nov, then declared war on GIE
Withdrew and dissolved its coalition on 28 Oct
Withdrew 28 Oct, threatened to return on 30 Oct
Made peace with Hawazan on 1 Nov

text.id: NATO menyatakan perang terhadap Hawazan.
text.en: NATO declares war on Hawazan.

text.id: GAE ikut menyatakan perang, mendukung GIE dan RUOT.
text.en: GAE declares war in support of GIE and RUOT.

text.id: GIE merilis dokumen: Hawazan menyatakan perang 16 Okt.
text.en: GIE releases a file saying Hawazan declared war on 16 Oct.

text.id: NATO bubar di tengah perang.
text.en: NATO disbands mid-war.

text.id: Hawazan menyatakan perang terhadap UDC; UDC membalas, Pearlcat HQ bergabung.
text.en: Hawazan declares war on the UDC; the UDC answers and Pearlcat HQ joins.

text.id: RUOT mundur dan membubarkan koalisinya.
text.en: RUOT withdraws and dissolves its coalition.

text.id: GAE mundur dari perang.
text.en: GAE withdraws from the war.

text.id: Cold Front Alliance (UN) membuka pengadilan terhadap Hawazan.
text.en: The Cold Front Alliance (UN) opens a court case against Hawazan.

text.id: TPE mundur dari perang.
text.en: TPE withdraws from the war.

text.id: Hawazan menyatakan perang terhadap TPE.
text.en: Hawazan declares war on TPE.

text.id: UDC dan koalisinya bersumpah terus berperang.
text.en: The UDC and its coalition vow to keep fighting.

text.id: URFR menyatakan perang terhadap Hawazan.
text.en: URFR declares war on Hawazan.

text.id: SDU menyatakan mundur.
text.en: SDU announces its withdrawal.

text.id: Hawazan minta maaf dan menawarkan gencatan senjata 48 jam.
text.en: Hawazan apologises and offers a 48-hour ceasefire.

text.id: Hawazan memberi ultimatum 12 jam ke AOCTL.
text.en: Hawazan gives AOCTL a 12-hour ultimatum.

text.id: Hawazan dan URFR berdamai.
text.en: Hawazan and URFR make peace.

text.id: Hawazan bersekutu dengan Black Cat Central V2.
text.en: Hawazan allies with Black Cat Central V2.

text.id: SDU dan koalisi menolak perundingan damai.
text.en: SDU and the coalition refuse peace talks.

text.id: AOCTL menolak ultimatum: "Bring it on."
text.en: AOCTL rejects the ultimatum: "Bring it on."

text.id: Hawazan dan AOCTL saling menyalahkan atas gagalnya perundingan.
text.en: Hawazan and AOCTL blame each other for the failed talks.

text.id: Hawazan menantang AOCTL bertempur 3v3.
text.en: Hawazan challenges AOCTL to a 3v3 battle.

text.id: Hawazan mengklaim menang atas koalisi; belum diverifikasi.
text.en: Hawazan claims victory over the coalition; unverified.

text.id: UDC bubar untuk rebranding.
text.en: The UDC disbands to rebrand.

text.id: GIE mengeluarkan dua faksi dari koalisi, salah satunya AOCTL.
text.en: GIE expels two factions from the coalition, one of them AOCTL.

text.id: SDU keluar dari koalisi; satu pertempuran terakhir 7 Nov.
text.en: SDU leaves the coalition; one last battle on 7 Nov.

summary.id: Black Cat Central (BCC) terus menambah musuh. Pada 4 Nov BCC menyatakan perang ke 16 faksi sekaligus, termasuk UN dan admin Slop Company, dengan alasan "cus we liek dat". Sejak 1 Nov BCC V2 bersekutu dengan Hawazan.
summary.en: Black Cat Central (BCC) keeps adding enemies. On 4 Nov it declared war on 16 factions at once, including the UN and the Slop Company admins, giving the reason "cus we liek dat". BCC V2 has been allied with Hawazan since 1 Nov.

note.id: Perang penuh sejak 27 Okt; BCC mengaku menyusupkan mata-mata
note.en: Full-scale war since 27 Oct; BCC claims it planted a spy

note.id: Menyatakan perang 1 Nov, didukung British Empire, Russian Bears dan Colgate Crest
note.en: Declared war on 1 Nov, backed by the British Empire, Russian Bears and Colgate Crest
Ended the alliance, then attacked on 27 Oct

note.id: Mundur 1 Nov karena salah sasaran, diserang lagi 4 Nov
note.en: Withdrew 1 Nov as a mix-up, targeted again 4 Nov
Joined to defend allies on 26 Oct

text.id: BCC menyatakan perang ke UDC, EU, RUOT dan GOC; GIE berjanji membela sekutunya.
text.en: BCC declares war on the UDC, EU, RUOT and GOC; GIE pledges to defend its allies.

text.id: WDU dan BCC memutus aliansi.
text.en: WDU and BCC end their alliance.

text.id: GOC menyatakan perang penuh terhadap BCC.
text.en: GOC declares full-scale war on BCC.

text.id: UDC menyebut deklarasi BCC ilegal.
text.en: The UDC calls BCC's declaration illegal.

text.id: WDU menyatakan perang terhadap BCC.
text.en: WDU declares war on BCC.

text.id: BCC menyatakan perang ke Phoenician Empire dan AOCTL.
text.en: BCC declares war on the Phoenician Empire and AOCTL.

text.id: BCC menyatakan perang ke SDU.
text.en: BCC declares war on the SDU.

text.id: UDC menjatuhkan sanksi penuh ke BCC.
text.en: The UDC places full sanctions on BCC.

text.id: USIIA menyatakan perang terhadap BCC.
text.en: USIIA declares war on BCC.

text.id: Black Aurum menyatakan perang terhadap BCC V2.
text.en: Black Aurum declares war on BCC V2.

text.id: USIIA mundur: BCC salah mengira mereka musuh.
text.en: USIIA withdraws: BCC had mistaken it for an enemy.

text.id: BCC mengaku menyusupkan mata-mata ke GOC selama seminggu.
text.en: BCC claims it had a spy inside GOC for a week.

text.id: TIC memperingatkan BCC dan Hawazan agar berhenti menyerang anggotanya.
text.en: TIC warns BCC and Hawazan to stop targeting its members.

text.id: GAE menyatakan perang terhadap BCC.
text.en: GAE declares war on BCC.

text.id: SDU mundur dari perang melawan BCC.
text.en: SDU withdraws from the war against BCC.

text.id: TIC menyatakan perang total terhadap BCC.
text.en: TIC declares total war on BCC.

text.id: BCC menyatakan perang ke 16 faksi sekaligus.
text.en: BCC declares war on 16 factions at once.

summary.id: Setelah dikeluarkan dari koalisi, Army of Christ Our Lord menyatakan perang ke GIE dan mengajak TIC serta Hawazan bersekutu. Menurut GIE, Hawazan sudah menolak ajakan AOCTL.
summary.en: After being expelled from the coalition, Army of Christ Our Lord declared war on GIE and invited TIC and Hawazan to ally with it. According to GIE, Hawazan already turned AOCTL down.

text.id: GIE mengeluarkan AOCTL dari koalisi.
text.en: GIE expels AOCTL from the coalition.

text.id: AOCTL menyatakan perang terhadap GIE.
text.en: AOCTL declares war on GIE.

summary.id: RUOT menyatakan perang ke Republic of Dominia karena kedekatannya dengan Hawazan; tujuh menit kemudian permusuhan dinyatakan tidak ada.
summary.en: RUOT declared war on the Republic of Dominia over its ties with Hawazan; seven minutes later hostilities were declared over.

text.id: RUOT menyatakan perang terhadap Dominia.
text.en: RUOT declares war on Dominia.

text.id: Pihak RUOT: "hostilities are none".
text.en: RUOT side: "hostilities are none".

text.id: Pendiri RUOT meminta maaf ke Dominia.
text.en: RUOT's founder apologises to Dominia.
